   bytes.
requirements.condition: for the protected packet in this sample packet-protection example
requirements.required_behavior: produce a protected packet of 21 bytes, the smallest possible packet size
requirements.forbidden_behavior: produce a packet smaller than 21 bytes for this example
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized protected packet can be measured directly and checked for the specified 21-byte length.
